children: The dollar eases but stays near the 19-month high reached overnight after the minutes of the Federal Reserve's latest meeting pointed to further interest rate rises. The minutes, published Wednesday, suggested the decision to keep interest rates unchanged in October was a close call and most policymakers thought higher rates were needed to bring down inflation. "Notably, a couple of participants said a hike of more than 25 basis points could be considered in December if incoming inflation data were unfavorable, which it since has been," Danske Bank analysts say in a note. The DXY dollar index falls 0.1% to 103.794, having risen to 103.974 overnight, its highest level since April 2025. (renae.dyer@wsj.com)
